steps.caption: Search for the company — here, Zentrix Analytics.
Ask AI sits in the top bar on every page (shortcut Ctrl+J).
The panel opens on the right. 'Viewing' shows the record it will use: Company · Zentrix Analytics.
Suggested questions are tailored to this record — or type your own.
Ask about 'this company' — no need to type its name.
The answer is built only from your records: profile, leases, contacts.
Unknown facts stay 'Unknown' — the assistant never guesses them.
Sources show where each part came from and how sure it is (Reported, Confirmed…).
'Missing / not verified' lists the gaps, e.g. no identified decision-maker.
Turn the answer into a deck, Word doc or PDF, or copy it. Thumbs up/down teach it what helped.
'Open full chat' continues the same conversation on the big Ask AI page.
Close the panel — you're still on the company page.
